programme.title: Insaaf: The Final Justice
programme.desc: When a witness is killed, a truthful police officer embarks on a mission to catch the culprit and uncovers a terrifying truth.

programme.title: Bekhudi
programme.desc: Radhika agrees to marry the boy her parents choose for her. Later, she falls in love with Rohit. The parents and her fiancé get together to force her to comply with their wishes.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Siddharth must swing into action when his girlfriend and her family are kidnapped and held for ransom by bandits. With danger lurking at every step, the family safari becomes a fight for survival.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss, Siddharth, is a womaniser who exploits Rahul into helping him win over Seema. However, Rahul ends up falling for Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and her.

programme.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
programme.desc: Renu helps Raju acquire a job in her company and later, they both fall in love with each other. However, things take a turn when his success makes him arrogant.

programme.title: Pardes
programme.desc: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his NRI son; he gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter. However, she seems to share a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.

programme.title: Koyla
programme.desc: Silenced by a piece of smouldering coal in childhood, Shankar endures a life of slavery until love compels him to seek his voice, freedom, and long-overdue revenge.

programme.title: Karan Arjun
programme.desc: Karan and Arjun, two brothers driven by revenge, are murdered by their uncle while seeking justice for their father's death. However, they resurrect years later to settle their unfinished score.

programme.title: Kurukshetra
programme.desc: ACP Prithviraj, an honest man, arrests Chief Minister Baburao's son for raping a woman. Consequently, Baburao leaves no stone unturned to get revenge against Prithviraj.

programme.title: Salaami
programme.desc: After Vijay, a young army cadet, finds evidence against the corrupt officer, Gautam, he gets entangled in a never-ending battle with the police, which puts his career and his family in trouble.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer has a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. While attempting to gather evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But, they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Gaddaar
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman's son manipulates a loyal friend into his personal schemes, but unexpected love and rising tensions threaten to unravel their lives.

programme.title: Radha Ka Sangam

programme.title: Jigar

programme.title: Ghayal
programme.desc: Balwant Rai, a corrupt businessman, frames Ajay for the murder of his brother. Later, with no support from those close to him, Ajay takes an unlikely route to seek revenge.

programme.desc: Balraj, an honest man, joins hands with a gangster in order to avenge his father's death. However, his upstanding brother Ajay opposes him as a police inspector.
